_comment: OpenSpec register fragment — capability-requirements-backfill task T30 (REQ-BQCV-030). One OPTIONAL property on Application, declared BEFORE anything writes it: `demoRecords`, the records buildiq generated from the app's own schemas when a maker asked for demo data. Listing them is what marks them as demo data, so removing them deletes exactly these and keeps every record a maker created. Absent or empty means the app has no demo records.

demoRecords.title: Demo Records
demoRecords.description: The demo records buildiq generated for this app from its own schemas, on a maker's request (REQ-BQCV-030). "Remove demo records" deletes exactly these; records a maker created are not listed and are kept.

register.title: Register
register.description: The register the demo record is in: the app's production register when it was made.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: Slug of the schema the demo record was generated from.
